findings.text: follow-on: the finally fallback `if reason is None and self._stopping: reason = _SIGNALLED_REASON` (session_host.py:570) and the request-descriptor EOF path `if not chunk: break` (session_host.py:536) are unasserted -- no test drives a bare request_stop() with no wake-pipe write, nor an EOF on the request descriptor, so stop_reason None has no test. The signal test reaches the wake branch (session_host.py:548-550) which already sets the reason, so the fallback line cannot fail on any current test and a regression deleting it would pass the gate.

follow-on: `host.stop()` in the run entry's finally (session_host.py:609) is a second call site of the terminator that now carries a reason and passes none; it would record stop_reason None if it ever fired first. In practice supervise's own finally (session_host.py:571-572) has already stopped and set _stopped, so this call site returns at the guard and is a no-op -- the reason contract is simply unenforced there, not violated.

justifications.durability: the two behaviours are proven by mutation: the base arm in the run's own negative-control.log reddens test_the_record_names_the_owner_* and test_the_record_names_a_signal at EXIT=1, and the tests are real -- they spawn an actual session host process, drive it through a real child and a real owner end, and send a real SIGTERM. The gap is coverage of the None and fallback paths: the EOF break (session_host.py:536) and the finally fallback (session_host.py:570) have no test, and the signal test exercises the wake branch rather than the fallback.
justifications.evidence: the manifest records the gate result rather than claiming it, and the head arm is independently reproducible: I reran the exact command at the reviewed head 2611d019 in the reviewed worktree (review-gate.log) and got 17 passed EXIT=0. The caveat is that the run's own gate log header names revision e3926b272 (the base) because the gate ran at 18:01 before the commit at 18:02:30, so the run's log cannot by itself tie the green result to the committed object; the independent rerun at 2611d019 closes that gap.
justifications.fit: the change follows the module's idioms: module-level reason constants beside the existing ones with a why-comment, a docstring paragraph stating the mechanism (the stop time is taken at the start of the stop), type-hinted payload assembly, and a comment at the conditional record write. No symbol, comment or filename carries a plan, ticket, sprint or version label; the two reason strings are mechanism names, not labels.
justifications.goal_fidelity: stop() at session_host.py:461, record() at session_host.py:301 and the reason threading at session_host.py:536-572 together place the stop time and reason into the final record only, with 'owner ended' on the owner check and 'signalled' on the self-pipe wake, matching the section goal and both done_when readings exactly.
justifications.reuse: the change reuses the module's `_now` clock, `_stop_child`, and the single `_write_record(force=True)` terminator; it adds no second record writer and no duplicate stop path, so the census has one writer and one terminator as the brief required.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff e3926b272..2611d019 touches exactly reckon/crew/session_host.py, tests/test_session_host.py and the evidence fragment, all inside the declared write paths, 89 insertions against 3 deletions across three files; reckon/crew/dispatch.py, which another node owned, is untouched.
